# Ingots

> The Ingots ecosystem: a set of independent packages in the
> [ak-ingots](https://github.com/ak-ingots) organization.

## Ecosystem

- [Ecosystem overview](README.md): repositories and how to work with them
- [Agent rules](CLAUDE.md): GitHub access, commit approval, ecosystem rules in short
- [Architecture decisions](docs/adr/README.md): ecosystem-wide ADRs (process, platforms, layout, composition, contract tests, design principles, code layout, moving the dependents, names of gRPC contracts and their paths, the location of contract tests, designing a feature before building it, the names of the RPCs, the names of the classes by their kind or role)
- [Design template](docs/design/template.md): the design of a feature before its code - actors, domain, stories accepted by code, flows, a prototype checked by mypy, threats, slices (ADR 0012)
- [The load](docs/design/load/README.md): the load of the addons - a scenario a project of `ingots.perf`, a stand of each addon in its `perf/<stand>`, the runner in `perf/` of this repository
- [Extension composition concepts](docs/design/extension-composition/README.md): the dynamic, static and slots prototypes compared for ADR 0004
- [logo-gen](https://github.com/ak-ingots/logo-gen/blob/main/README.md): the ecosystem logo and its generator (3D ingot scene -> SVG/PNG)
- [ingots](https://github.com/ak-ingots/ingots/blob/main/README.md): the framework core - statically typed composition of applications from reusable addons (ADR 0004); rewritten from scratch, on PyPI since 0.30.0
- [ingot-settings](https://github.com/ak-ingots/ingot-settings/blob/main/README.md): an addon with sources and formats for the settings of `ingots.defaults` beyond the standard library; YAML files so far, loaders for cloud secret managers next
- [ingot-grpcio](https://github.com/ak-ingots/ingot-grpcio/blob/main/README.md): an addon integrating grpcio, the gRPC library of Google; the servers, the clients, the errors and the export of the services; its cost under the load against grpcio alone
- [ingot-pymongo](https://github.com/ak-ingots/ingot-pymongo/blob/main/README.md): an addon integrating PyMongo, the official driver of MongoDB, on its asynchronous API; the clients of MongoDB servers, as components
- [ingot-redis](https://github.com/ak-ingots/ingot-redis/blob/main/README.md): an addon integrating redis-py, the official client of Redis, on its asynchronous API; the clients of Redis servers, as components
- [ingot-mail](https://github.com/ak-ingots/ingot-mail/blob/main/README.md): an addon for the mail of applications - the mail of plain text with its headers, the mailer and its contract, the mailers in memory and of SMTP on aiosmtplib
- [ingot-starlette](https://github.com/ak-ingots/ingot-starlette/blob/main/README.md): an addon integrating Starlette, the ASGI framework, as it is; the project inside the application of Starlette a server imports, its subtrees: the API of JSON alone, the WebSockets, a resource of a state for each connection, and the pages of HTML; the endpoints in slots, a tree of routes, the callers, the policies of the errors as its exception handlers; its cost under the load against Starlette alone
- [ingot-auth](https://github.com/ak-ingots/ingot-auth/blob/main/README.md): an addon for the sign-up, the sign-in and the sessions of the users of an application, assuming no details of them; the sign-up and the sign-in by methods in steps, their policies, the sessions, the groups of the users, over gRPC, in MongoDB and Redis, the mail by ingot-mail; on PyPI since 0.1.0, documented on Read the Docs as a subproject of ingots

## Optional

- [Repository list](repos.txt): clone order, dependencies first
- [Meta commands](Makefile): clone, pull, status, check, prs, ci, dep-tree, dep-behind, dep-next, dep-try
- [The runner of the load](perf/README.md): `make -C perf run STAND=<addon>/perf/<stand>`, the host checked and tuned
